messages:
maria.garcia: Hey team — after the org-label migration this morning, a customer reported that invited members see 403 when opening the project console. "You don't have permission to view this resource." Repro steps below.

sam.kim: Can you paste repro steps & org id? Also any console logs or request id.

maria.garcia: Steps:
1) Login to console
2) Switch to org AcmeCorp (org_id: org_9a8b7c)
3) Click Projects -> select project 'acme-prod'
Observed: 403 modal.
Curl trace:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/acme-prod | jq
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"forbidden","message":"You do not have permission"}
```
Affects 3 invited users; they were added pre-migration.
Ticket: SUPPORT-12345

support-bot: Support ticket SUPPORT-12345 created and linked.

lucy.srebot: I see role-sync job for org_9a8b7c failed at 2026-03-17T04:12Z with 502 from identity-service. Log snippet:
```
[04:12:03Z] sync-rolebinds: error fetching groups: GET /idp/groups -> 502 Bad Gateway
[04:12:04Z] sync-rolebinds: aborting job, retry_count=3
```
Looks like label rename changed group mapping keys; sync aborted leaving users in 'pending' state.

jordan.eng: Short-term workaround: manually grant project.viewer role via API for those users:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_9a8b7c/projects/acme-prod/roles \
 -d '{"user_email":"user@acme.com","role":"project.viewer"}'
```
That should unblock until sync is fixed.

sam.kim: @lucy can you trigger a retry of the role-sync for that org and check whether group->role mapping reconciles? Also confirm whether we need to clear any cache for project role lookup.

lucy.srebot: Triggered manual retry at 2026-03-17T04:38Z. After retry we got 200 and bindings reconciled. Also cleared in-memory auth cache for org_9a8b7c. Waiting on @maria to confirm with customer.

maria.garcia: Confirmed with customer — users can access projects again. They had to re-open the console. All good. :tada:

sam.kim: Closing loop — root cause: group mapping keys changed during label migration causing role-sync to fail (502) and leave rolebindings orphaned. Action items: add validation to label-migrate job, add alert when role-sync aborts, and add automatic retry with backoff. I'll file RFC.

maria.garcia: Thanks everyone, will update SUPPORT-12345 with notes and the workaround we applied. :heart:
